title: FilterBar
description: Fiori filter bar with declarative condition editors, built-in Adapt Filters personalization, ordered visibility, live search, required-field validation and SAPUI5 active-filter summaries.

usage.summary: Let users limit a result collection by several criteria in the page header.
useWhen: Help users narrow objects in a list report or other result page using several filter criteria.
Let users combine a keyword search with typed fields, then inspect the active-filter summary.
Use liveMode for updates after committed condition changes; otherwise use onGo for manual search.

avoidWhen.when: Filter a table inside an object-page section rather than a result-page header.
Find items in a list using only a keyword query.
Personalize only filter-field visibility, order and conditions in a separate dialog.
Manage named saved views rather than edit the current filter criteria.
Guide users through data-entry steps rather than filter a result collection.
